questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Scientists all over the world are engaged in ______ how to find a vaccine for COVID-19.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'investigating'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the **meanings **of the given words-

 
 
• **Scrutinizing**- to examine something very carefully (किसी चीज की बहुत सावधानी से जांच करना)
 
• **Investigating**- to try to discover the facts about something. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में सभी तथ्यों को खोजने की कोशिश करना)

• Here, the word **investigating** is more applicable as the sentence implies that scientists are closely searching for facts related to the vaccine.
 
• Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

He won’t come to the party unless you __will invite__ him personally.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'invite'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the usage of 'will invite' is incorrect instead of it use 'invite'
 
• According to grammar, whenever we have a main clause and subordinate clause in the conditional sentence, the usage of will is incorrect in the subordinate clauses hence, we need to omit 'will' from the subordinate clause.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• Unless you call me to say you're not coming, I'll see you at the theatre (= I will see you there if you do not call to say you are not coming).
 
 

**Hence, the correct sentence is-** *He won't come to the party unless **you invite** him personally.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__***

 
• The word "invited" is in the past tense, and using it in this context would imply that the invitation would have already occurred in the past. However, the sentence is speaking about a future event (the party) and a condition that must be met in the future (the personal invitation).
 
• The verb tenses in the two parts of this conditional sentence need to match. If the first part is in the future tense ("He won't come to the party"), then the second part also needs to be in a tense that refers to future action. The base form of the verb ("invite") is used here to express a condition in the present or future.
 
• If we were talking about a past event, "invited" could be correct. For example: "He didn't come to the party unless you invited him personally."
 
• So, "invite" is the correct option in this context.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Boomerang-** a curved stick that, when thrown in a particular way, comes back to the person who threw it or curved throwing stick used chiefly by the Aboriginals of Australia for hunting and warfare. (एक घुमावदार छड़ी, जो किसी विशेष तरीके से फेंकने पर, उस व्यक्ति के पास वापस आती है जिसने इसे फेंक दिया था या मुख्य रूप से ऑस्ट्रेलिया के आदिवासियों द्वारा शिकार और युद्ध के लिए इस्तेमाल की जाने वाली घुमावदार छड़ी।)
 
• **Slingshot- **a Y-shaped stick or piece of metal with a piece of elastic (= material that stretches) attached to the top parts, used especially by children for shooting small stones (एक वाई-आकार की छड़ी या धातु का टुकड़ा जिसमें लोचदार का एक टुकड़ा होता है (= सामग्री जो फैलती है) शीर्ष भागों से जुड़ी होती है, विशेष रूप से छोटे पत्थरों की शूटिंग के लिए बच्चों द्वारा उपयोग की जाती है)
 
• **Harpoon-** a long, heavy spear (= a long, sharp weapon) attached to a rope, used for killing large fish or whales (एक लंबा, भारी भाला (= एक लंबा, नुकीला हथियार) एक रस्सी से जुड़ा होता है, जिसका इस्तेमाल बड़ी मछली या व्हेल को मारने के लिए किया जाता है)
 
• **Cutlass- **a curved sword with a single sharp edge, especially as used in the past by pirates (एक तेज धार वाली घुमावदार तलवार, विशेष रूप से अतीत में समुद्री लुटेरों द्वारा उपयोग की जाने वाली तलवार)
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is **Option 1 i.e. Boomerang.**
